newsitem.title: USA: Rate of Japan c/a surplus rise seen slowing.
newsitem.headline: Rate of Japan c/a surplus rise seen slowing.

text.p: The recent rise in Japan's current account surplus is not linked to structural factors and the pace at which the surplus is rising is set to slow down, a Japanese international finance source said on Wednesday.

"The current account has been rising in the past couple of months but we do not see any structural elements there, so we think the increase would slow down," the source, who asked not to be identified, told reporters.
The International Monetary Fund, in its annual review of the Japanese economy, said on Wednesday it saw no reason to worry about Japan's present current account surplus.
But it foresaw possible retaliation by Japan's trading partners if the surplus began a sustained rise.
